# Self-Healing Storefront Agent
Agent self-instrumentation (OTLP). Observe -> diagnose -> decide -> act -> verify, with a human approval gate.

4.title: Approval gate spans
4.query: fetch spans | filter service.name == "self-healing-storefront-agent" | filter span.name == "approval_gate" | fields start_time, `gate.decision`, `tool.name` | sort start_time desc | limit 25

5.title: Recent agent spans
5.query: fetch spans | filter service.name == "self-healing-storefront-agent" | fields start_time, span.name, duration | sort start_time desc | limit 25
